verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the install docs, which say Meilisearch can be installed locally "from source" ([meilisearch-docs-44]). That implies the source code is available to read, but nothing in the pack names the license or confirms it is open. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license, a link to a public source repository, and independent corroboration of source availability and license terms.
